user_facing_rules.normal_answers: Normal Codex answers remain detailed and helpful. Minimal Mode applies ONLY to memory ingestion, not to user-facing responses.
user_facing_rules.memory_ingestion: Memory records are minimal (≤500 chars) with evidence_path and caveat. User can request review before ingestion.
user_facing_rules.socratic_questions: Socratic questions appear ONLY for high-risk ambiguity (direction conflict, release boundary, security, unclear scope). Max 3 questions. Normal phases do not trigger Socratic.
